title: 5 Costs a Godly Man Pays Before Anyone Asks Him To
caption:
Nobody's billing him for any of this. He pays first anyway.

He apologizes before you've decided how mad to be. He starts the hard conversation before it curdles into a grudge. He shows up on the day he'd rather skip, and he carries blame that isn't fully his so the people counting on him aren't left standing exposed.

And when leaving would cost him nothing and no one would blame him for it, he stays.

None of it gets announced first. "The Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many." Matthew 20:28.

Save this for the guy learning that leadership isn't the title. It's what he pays before anyone asks him to.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
